2026-04-13T17:30:59.1638126Z 
2026-04-13T17:30:59.1644831Z ## Why No PR Was Created
2026-04-13T17:30:59.1645068Z 
2026-04-13T17:30:59.1645183Z ```
2026-04-13T17:30:59.1645627Z ! 2 MCP servers were blocked by policy: 'github', 'safeoutputs'
2026-04-13T17:30:59.1646101Z ```
2026-04-13T17:30:59.1646230Z 
2026-04-13T17:30:59.6643064Z The Copilot CLI fetches MCP server policy from `https://api.github.com/copilot/mcp_registry`. Since `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` is excluded from the container environment (it's replaced by the API proxy), this check returns **401 Unauthorized**. The CLI then blocks all non-default MCP servers — including safeoutputs — making `create_pull_request` and `noop` unavailable.
2026-04-13T17:30:59.6644799Z 
2026-04-13T17:31:00.5798325Z The `outputs.jsonl` is also mounted read-only inside the agent container, making direct writes impossible. Without safeoutputs tool calls, the PR creation job won't run.
2026-04-13T17:31:00.5799552Z 
2026-04-13T17:31:01.7602981Z **This is an infrastructure-level issue** that will affect every run until the MCP registry policy check is fixed (e.g., by using a dedicated token for the registry check that doesn't require `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`).

2026-04-13T17:31:05.9922971Z

2026-04-13T17:31:06.0124369Z   
2026-04-13T17:31:06.0125835Z   The Copilot CLI fetches MCP server policy from `https://api.github.com/copilot/mcp_registry`. Since `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` is excluded from the container environment (it's replaced by the API proxy), this check returns **401 Unauthorized**. The CLI then blocks all non-default MCP servers — including safeoutputs — making `create_pull_request` and `noop` unavailable.
2026-04-13T17:31:06.0125903Z   
2026-04-13T17:31:06.0126395Z   The `outputs.jsonl` is also mounted read-only inside the agent container, making direct writes impossible. Without safeoutputs tool calls, the PR creation job won't run.
2026-04-13T17:31:06.0126519Z   
2026-04-13T17:31:06.0127124Z   **This is an infrastructure-level issue** that will affect every run until the MCP registry policy check is fixed (e.g., by using a dedicated token for the registry check that doesn't require `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`).
